Common names

Source: R/sacha_clb.R
common_names.Rd

Retrieves the vernacular names of a species from the configured source, grouped by language. Names in Spanish are listed without a language label. Names in other languages are followed by the language in parentheses, and names without a declared language are marked with a localized "unspecified" label. Language codes reported by the source are normalized for Spanish ("es"); other codes are kept as reported, with the country appended when available. Groups are separated by "; ".

common_names(species, language = NULL)

common_names_md(species, language = NULL)

Arguments

species

Character scalar with a scientific name of at least a genus and a specific epithet, for example "Bidens andicola". Surrounding and repeated whitespace is removed. Vectors of length greater than one, NA and single-word names are rejected with an error.

language

Language of labels and messages: a YAML basename in inst/lang/ (for example "en" or "es") or a declared alias (for example "english" or "spanish"). NULL (default) uses the language set with sacha_configure(). It does not translate the citation. Unsupported values raise an error.

Value

  • common_names(): the names as a character string, or a localized no-data or connection message.

  • common_names_md(): invisibly, a Markdown line with a bold localized "common names" label followed by the names, or "" when no names are available. The line is also written to the console.

See also

sacha_configure(), accessors-sacha

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
common_names("Bidens andicola")

common_names("Bidens andicola", language = "es")

common_names_md("Bidens andicola")
} # }
